claims.text: A global look at adult literacy levels, comparing high-performing nations with those facing literacy challenges based on World Bank data.
claims.support: World Bank Adult Literacy Rate data.

claims.text: In Uzbekistan, adult literacy is 100%. In Chad, it is 30.6%.
Uzbekistan leads all nations on the map, with universal reading and writing.
The lowest nations include Chad at 30.6%, Niger at 35.6%, Mali at 35.6%, and Burkina Faso at 41.6%.
claims.support: Chad rank: 107 (30.6%), Niger rank: 106 (35.6%), Mali rank: 105 (35.6%), Burkina Faso rank: 103 (41.6%)

claims.text: In Asia, China has 96.7%, while India has 78.2%.
Brazil, the largest nation in South America, has 94.7%.
The metric counts people ages 15 and above who can read and write a short simple statement about everyday life.
claims.support: Adult literacy rate is the percentage of people ages 15 and above who can both read and write with understanding a short simple statement about their everyday life.
